subject: Music Production
title: AI Enters the Studio
description: A fast breakdown of AI Enters the Studio for builders.

hook.text: In the 2020s, artificial intelligence tools began generating beats, melodies, and vocal tracks.

buildup.text: AI could analyze thousands of songs and create compositions matching any requested style or mood.

discovery.text: Producers started using AI as a creative partner, generating ideas they could refine and polish.

twist.text: Legal battles erupted over whether AI-generated music could be copyrighted or owned by anyone.

climax.text: The music industry found itself debating what it means to create in the age of machines.

punchline.text: Machines started composing, and nobody owns the output.

quiz.question: What legal question did AI-generated music raise?
options: Whether AI music could be copyrighted
Whether AI could replace concert venues
